description.value: Loon Lagoon is the indoor aquatic and wellness facility at Manning Park Resort, featuring a 50-ft heated swimming pool, hot tubs, a steam room, and a sauna. Situated along the Highway 3 cycling corridor in Manning Provincial Park, it is open to day visitors as well as resort guests, giving touring cyclists a rare chance to recover properly after crossing the Cascades. An on-site fitness centre with cardio equipment and free weights adds to the recovery options.

On-site food and beverage (Pinewoods Restaurant, Bear's Den Pub) are confirmed via the hours subpage. No bike parking, bike racks, showers distinct from the pool facility, or any other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so those remain null per evidence rules.
